title: Output size of the stock 4K movie request: 3840 x 2160 -> 3840 x 2560 (size class 3, second entry)
status: addresses from emulating the FX6's own size-table function; never read or written on an FX6. The same word change (outsz2560_fx3_v1) works on two FX3s

sites.what: size class 3, second entry: width, height

guards.what: size class 3, first entry and the raw write buffer id

precondition: a movie picture set-up has run (the table is zero before; the FX6 has no stills mode, so it is filled once the camera has started); the word is written during a USB session, while the camera's picture is stopped
restore: the old word, or a cold boot
not_shown: the output records' format code on this camera (2 on the A7 IV: 3840 x 2560 x 1.25 = 12,288,000 bytes fits the 13,271,040-byte units of id 0x2d9)
